SLE.note: The data centre named is a component of a rural telephony project, not said to rent space or computing to others.

facts.fact: The Universal Access Development Fund's CEO says its Rural Telephony Project, launched across five rural communities, has connected approximately 47,700 people across 114 rural and remote localities, with over 30 schools and about 10 health centres served.

systems.platform: VSAT, microwave and fibre links with five towers

SLE.note: The document states nothing on local government office connections.

VSAT serves the project's own rural sites; no satellite broadband licensed or sold to households or businesses is stated.
